headline: Resident Evil 2: Leon and Claire
title: Resident Evil 2 Facts | Raccoon City 1998 | Classic Games
video_script: Resident Evil two is a survival horror game from Capcom, released for the PlayStation in nineteen ninety eight. You play rookie cop Leon Kennedy or Claire Redfield, who is Chris Redfield's sister, escaping Raccoon City after its people were turned into zombies. Each hero has a different scenario, with different partners and obstacles. A full remake arrived in January twenty nineteen. Leon or Claire? Comment below!
description: Resident Evil 2 (Capcom, 1998, PlayStation): play Leon Kennedy or Claire Redfield in Raccoon City; a remake came in January 2019. Sources: Wikipedia, StrategyWiki.
